verdict.rationale: A secrets-scanning product with an enterprise web UI could plausibly ship a built-in AI assistant, so this axis applies. The evidence pack covers only scanning, verification, analysis, pre-commit hooks, custom detectors and alert routing, with no mention of an in-product AI assistant that users can hand tasks to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
